Introduction

Park Chanyeol is a South Korean rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor under SM Entertainment. He debuted in 2012 as a member of the South Korean boy group EXO and its sub-units EXO-K. He later debuted in the sub-unit EXO-SC, alongside member Sehun, in 2019.

In November 2019, Chanyeol launched a YouTube channel named "Studio NNG" for a project, in collaboration with an SM Entertainment Director MQ who also is a part of the performance group BeatBurger. Chanyeol enlisted as an active-duty soldier on March 29, 2021, and ended his military service on September 27, 2022.

Chanyeol had his official solo debut on August 28, 2024, with his first mini-album, Blackout.
